subject: RE: Evaluation roadmap & close timeline — weekly alignment
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation roadmap & close timeline — weekly alignment

Hi Samantha / David —

Thanks again for the time today. I wanted to summarize decisions from the MAP session and set clear owners + dates so we stay on track for the pilot sign-off by 2027-01-20. High level: the evaluation plan is stable, procurement will start contract review next week, and we agreed on a short SOC2 evidence ask before pilot kickoff.

Decisions / current status:
- Pilot scope: full-text search + summarization on internal support tickets (prod subset). Agreed.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in median time-to-first-draft for triage reps (measured against April baseline).
- Pilot timeline: data handoff 12/17, evaluation window 12/20–01/10, internal sign-off target 01/20.

Action items (owner — due):
- Samantha: confirm availability for 12/17 data-handoff window (one-hour slot) — due 12/09.
- Marissa: finalize test prompts and run initial ingestion dry-run — due 12/15. [Attachment: redwood-acme-map-v2.xlsx (xlsx)]
- Karthik: prepare pricing sketch for pilot scale (est. QPS + monthly) and share with procurement — due 12/14.
- Laura: provide SOC2 evidence pointers (scope + S3 retention) and a short checklist for Acme security — due 12/11. [Attachment: acme-soc2-evidence.pdf (pdf)]

Docs & links:
- MAP workbook (latest): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3CacmeMAP
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-EXPAND

Next meeting: weekly MAP sync Thurs 12/10 10:00am PT — primary agenda: ingestion status, initial eval criteria, procurement blockers. If any of the above owners need to reschedule, flag here and I'll rebook.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the line.

—
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: redwood-acme-map-v2.xlsx]

Michael — thanks for the clear summary. Quick updates from our side:

- 12/17 data-handoff: confirmed. Please send calendar invite with S3 access instructions and any pre-ingest transform guidance.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@acme.com this week; they asked for your pricing sketch and the SOC2 checklist.
- SOC2: we can provide environment screenshots and a short control matrix, but we may not be able to share full evidence before 12/20. Is the checklist sufficient for your security review?

One question: during the pilot, will logs/token data be retained in our VPC or on Redwood-managed telemetry? We need clarity for compliance.

Thanks — Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cho <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation roadmap & close timeline — weekly alignment

Thanks Sam — quick notes on the ingestion and eval prep:

- Dry-run: I executed a dry-run against a sanitized sample (50 tickets) and uploaded a short report to the MAP workbook. Findings: minor timestamp normalization required; two rare fields (legacy_ticket_id & external_ref) need mapping. I noted mapping in the workbook.
- Prompts: attached a starter set (in the MAP workbook) for triage and summarization; we'll iterate based on the first 200 records.
- Telemetry/retention: default pilot behavior is that logs and token traces remain in Redwood-managed ephemeral storage by default. If you need VPC-only retention, we can enable VPC-hosted logging but that will add ~8% to compute overhead and requires an additional onboarding step.

Action updates (from my side):
- Marissa: push final prompt pack + ingestion checklist to MAP workbook — done (12/11). [Attachment: redwood-acme-map-v2.xlsx]
- Marissa: schedule 12/17 data-handoff invite and include S3 key rotation instructions — pending (will send EOD 12/11).

Open blocker for security: if Acme needs all telemetry to remain inside their VPC, we need confirmation by 12/14 to enable the VPC logging path for the pilot.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: redwood-acme-map-v2.xlsx]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Evaluation roadmap & close timeline — weekly alignment

Appreciate the quick replies — short update and next steps before next week's sync:

- Samantha: thanks — calendar invite sent for 12/17 09:00–10:00 PT with S3 instructions in the description. Please confirm attendees.
- Laura: thanks for the SOC2 checklist — attaching the short checklist and our proposal version for procurement review. [Attachment: proposal-acme-v1.docx]
- Procurement: Karthik will send an initial pilot pricing sketch to procurement@acme.com by 12/14; if procurement wants redlines, please send them to legal@redwood.ai and I'll loop in our commercial counsel.
- VPC logging: Samantha — please confirm by 12/14 if you require VPC-only retention; otherwise we'll proceed with Redwood-managed ephemeral storage for the pilot. Note: choosing VPC path may shift sign-off timeline by ~3 business days.

Decisions recorded here will become the baseline for the pilot SOW in the proposal doc. If there are no objections, I'll mark items as committed and move the proposal to 'pilot-ready' for 01/05 internal review.

Next sync (recurring): Thurs 12/17 11:00am PT (post-handoff) — agenda: ingestion verification, early eval metrics, procurement status.

Thanks everyone — short and focused: confirm the three items above (attendees, SOC2 checklist sufficiency, VPC logging requirement) and we'll keep momentum.

—
Michael Grant
